title: FLA import: text field hasBackground flag not decoded from binary (only hasBorder is)
description: In flash8-binary.ts, CPicText decodes hasBorder from bit 0x40 of textFlags (line ~2060) and flash8-import.ts forwards it to the model. However there is NO hasBackground flag decoded anywhere — neither in flash8-binary.ts nor present in the model or SWF encoder. Flash 8 text fields have a separate 'background' property that draws a filled background rectangle behind the text. Fix: (1) decode the hasBackground bit from textFlags in flash8-binary.ts (likely 0x20 or adjacent bit — verify against flacomdoc), (2) add hasBackground to the text field model in engine/types.ts, (3) forward it through flash8-import.ts, (4) emit the HasBorder flag in DefineEditText encoding in packages/swf/src/text.ts. The SWF DefineEditText has a HasBorder flag (bit 11) that controls both border and background display.
